meaning:
1) to become evening, grow dark
1a) (Qal) to become evening, grow dark
1b) (Hiphil) to spend the evening, do at evening

elsewhere.note: When the man rose up to depart, he, and his concubine, and his servant, his father-in-law, the young lady’s father, said to him, “Behold, now the day draws…
The Philistine came near morning and evening, and presented himself forty days.
There is a crying in the streets because of the wine. All joy is darkened. The mirth of the land is gone.
